name: Ghost Cache
description: A hacker collective's file share has surfaced on the lab network, mixed with convincing decoys. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199) and recover the collective's authentic relay fragment.

tasks.name: Recover the relay fragment
tasks.description: On the lab network, scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199). Find the collective's file share and recover its authentic relay fragment from among the decoys.
hints: The share's public inventory contains several candidate accounts. Compare their details with what the service reveals.
Try the candidate credentials and pay attention to how the service responds; decoys do not grant access.
Use the pair that completes authentication, then inspect the files available in that account.
